🧠 ASIA SESSION SMC FOREX MAP — USDJPY + AUDJPY

Fresh market data | Daily → 4H → 1H → 15M
Session: Tokyo / Asia
No setup is an entry until 15M confirmation occurs.

🔥 STRONGEST ASIA SETUP — USDJPY BUY
Current: ~157.90

HTF READ
• Daily structure remains bullish after the sustained advance through 157.00 and 158.00.
• 4H structure is bullish, but price has just rejected the 158.30 liquidity area.
• 1H is pulling back into the 157.80–157.95 retest zone.
• 15M has started stabilising around 157.90 after the pullback.

🎯 PRIMARY LONG
Wait for a controlled retest into 157.80–157.95, then require bullish 15M displacement/reclaim.

Targets:
→ 158.16
→ 158.30
→ 158.45

Invalidation: sustained loss of ~157.57.

⚠️ BOJ EVENT RISK
Bank of Japan Governor Ueda is scheduled to speak during the Tokyo session. Avoid blind entries immediately before the event; confirmation after the volatility spike is preferable. citeturn0search2

🟢 AUDJPY BUY — SECONDARY
Current: ~110.09

HTF READ
• Daily structure has recovered strongly from the ~109.40 area.
• 4H remains bullish with price holding above 110.00.
• 1H shows a clean recovery from ~109.91 into the 110.18 liquidity area.
• 15M is consolidating above 110.00.

🎯 PRIMARY LONG
Wait for 110.02–110.06, then require bullish 15M displacement/reclaim.

Targets:
→ 110.18
→ 110.70
→ 111.00

Invalidation: sustained loss of ~109.91.

⚠️ ASIA VERDICT
USDJPY is the cleaner setup because the 4H trend is stronger and the 157.80–157.95 retracement gives a defined invalidation.

AUDJPY is also bullish, but the first target at 110.18 is relatively close, so patience for a deeper retest is important.

China remains closed for the holiday, so Asia liquidity is likely to be thinner than normal. citeturn0search2
